item.title: Scp of Future Past, and Everything Else...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:
Scp XXXX is a Reality Bender
Scp XXXX had been discovered in a cave near Quebec, Canada
Scp XXXX is spanned through time and space.

Central Narrative:
Scp XXXX was discovered by an Amateur Cave Explorer in 1973, in a cave near Quebec, Canada. The Amateur Cave Explorer was taken into Foundation custody and amnestisized, alongside all other civilians involved, after reporting to a local hospital, stating he heard a voice in his head talk about freeing himself from the wizards bonds. The Foundation learns Scp XXXX voice spreads into Humans Consciousness when any contact is made beit physical or verbal. The cave of origin is blocked and all Personnel that had been infected had been anesthetized. Scp XXXX is reclassified from euclid to safe. 14 years later, Dr. Mason Cooper reports hearing voices inside his head, though he had only been working for the Foundation for 11 years. Staff had concluded that Personnel already infected by Scp XXXX previously had seemed to get reinfected. Though some personnel had either left the Foundation and been Anesthetized or were somewhere else in the world. Scp XXXX is reclassified as keter as it now spreads into the entire world. As more and more instances of Scp XXXX begin to be heard in peoples head the more mist and fog begins to surround Scp XXXX’s point of origin. Until at a Estimated 1 000 000 cases where the fog slowly turned into a human like form and moved into Montreal, Canada. The Foundation theorizes that Scp XXXX was sent across space and time by the Wizards in 1200, so any Instance of Scp XXXX would imbalance its containment as it would be more in one time then the others, meaning it would start to remeterialize. The Foundation enlists Mobile Task Force Simga 32 ( Tbh I Dont Any Good Mtf Who Travel Through Time ) To travel to Canada and release a amnestic and start a PowerGrid Failure to all of Quebec to stop the spread of Media related to Scp XXXX, Finally Sigma 32 puts down a temporal rift near the anomaly, sending all living creatures in the radius to various points in the future in order to contain it. Scp XXXX is currently pending classification of either safe or neutralized.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The archived containment class would go from euclid to safe to keter to pending, meaning there is lots of story.

Additional Notes: If you could help find a name for the Scp Article and a Mtf that specializes in Time Travel I would be even more grateful, but if you just want to critique I'm still very thankful.

item.title: Buzzcut
item.description: A buzzer from the 1950's that grants you irresistible charisma.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Fantasy

Elevator Pitch: It's a barber buzzer. Upon using it on one's head, the individual starts receiving more attention than usual. Overtime, as hair grows, the attention diminishes, unless one cuts again, and instead attention increases. Attention, as well as sex appeal. Continuing the process allows the user to have increasing and overwhelming charisma to the extent that they can influence first people, then towns, then world events.

Central Narrative: The buzzer was found to be in the possession of an artifact dealer, and was purchased by the owner of a 50's themed diner to be placed in a safe with other memorabilia. Upon discovery by the Foundation, the dive owner says the girl he bought it from claims it was used by Elvis to cut his hair. After testing the piece is found to be non anamolous, placed in confinement, however an agent over the testing steals it to resell it, but not before trying it on his own head. He begins to notice his life change.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The fact the the influence builds on itself to make the user more and more powerful, and can be transferred if one single hair is buzzed on another man or woman. The buzzer also increases the physical strength of the individual and performance of physiological functions, to the extent that the user can not only become stronger than possible for a human, but also have a faster metabolism (speed), more god like features, and be a far greater sexy badboy/girl than humanly possible.

Additional Notes: After non-use of about a week, all influence dies out. It isn't saved within the buzzer. This is why, if the Elvis fact is true, Elvis, nor any of the other users' influence, is transferred to new users. Any stretch beyond humanly possible abilities granted by the buzzer is unnoticed by individuals, due to the overwhelming charisma, and is brushed off. There is no proper way to cut your hair with the buzzer, but upon doing so, everyone will love your haircut.

item.title: SCP-XXXX A blessed exchange
item.description: An object that exchanges two aspects(body parts/memories/facts) of a person for a new aspect.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Mystery

Page Layout: Object description and containment are minimal, and main focus will be on testing logs. There will be 10-15 of them, starting with mundane, and increasing in strangeness.

Elevator Pitch: The object swaps two aspects (body parts/memories/reality of their life) of a person with a new one, seemingly from its "collection" of obtained aspects. Since an unknown number of exchanges have occurred, over an unknown time/places, it has an unknowable number of aspects in its collection.

Central Narrative: Minimal. The testing logs will add mystery around the objects age/origins and purpose, suggesting alien/extra-dimensional life. Since the object can alter reality, detailed records and logs need to be kept in order to keep track of reality alterations.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The object removes aspects of a person and gives a brand new one. The removal of aspects could kill or dramatically change a person, even removing people/companies/ideas related to them. The new aspects can be memories, new organs, or reality altering itself as well. The testing logs will start with mundane things, eg gaining memories of another person, growing a new limb etc, and will progress to stranger exchanges where friends/family cease to exist, or they gain non-human knowledge. Adding to the intrigue is that every aspect "given" is assumed to have been taken at some stage, suggesting that the object has altered reality many times in the past in unknown ways.

item.title: (Awaiting greenlights) The elite soldier.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Action.

Elevator Pitch: The elite operative is a soldier that is trapped inside a suit. The suit has many abilities. It can withstand heavy kinetic damage, it has bullet resistance against small ammunition for example a 9.mm bullet and it gives the soldier super human strength. But there are other abilities that are in-humane and cruel, gas containers attached to the suit, set of torture tools inside the suit, and explosives full with diffrent types of poisons.

Central Narrative: The story starts in a Anderson robotics factory. Anderson robotics made a deal with the U.S. army to create suits that would give soldiers anomalous abilities. The first suit was tested, the U.S. army closed the deal off after they saw what horrible things the suit can do such as: containers full with gas, a set of torture tools inside the suit, Diffrent types of poisons inside deadly explosives. Only 3 were made two are still missing and the third one a soldier still wears. The foundation is still looking for the two missing suits. The SCP foundation heard about the suits and found a suit with the soldier inside. Verbal communication was not affective since any sound that the soldier would make is drowned by the heavy metal suit. All attempts to get the soldier out of the suit are in-affective. After finding out the soldier could not be freed, he was interviewed via radio and agreed to use the suit he is trapped in to help the foundation. He was classed a Thaumiel SCP and assigned to MTF Alpha-9 ("Last Hope") And used in the field. He was shipped to Site-06-3 awaiting deployment.

The suit's abilities are explained with addendums and mission logs. And the only way to communicate with the soldier is via radio.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Although many "robotic suit" ideas and SCP's are on the site. My idea is unique because of two reasons. 1, the SCP's abilities. It's super-human strength, resistance to small bullets and kinetic energy. I have yet to see a robotic SCP with such abilities on the site. And 2, It's friendly-ness towards humans and it's will to help them with raids, containment and more that they ask for. I did not see any other robotic SCP do this.

Additional Notes: Since I am quite new if anyone would like to give tips about the Hook/Attention grabber it would be very helpful. Thanks!

item.title: SCP Idea
item.description: I am new to the site and wish to make my mark on this site for fun.
item.content:encoded:
Page type: New SCP idea
So my SCP is a man in a hot air balloon that is designated safe as he doesn't attack anything. The Hot-Air balloon itself can reach up to extremely fast speeds and stop on a time and do things such as move in any direction or things like barrel rolls. A real physics breaking type entity. For example, the Balloon can easily reach Mach 3 and then stop instantly with no inertia, no drag, nothing and the man in said balloon doesn't fly out of the balloon or do any type of bracing for the oncoming stop. The SCP itself can initiate maneuvers such as barrel rolls.

From what I read I have to get the concept greenlight then the draft and then the final green light for it to become and "Canon" article.

item.title: A Thousand Door (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror, Exploration, Ambiance

Page Layout: Standard SCP Article with Explorations Logs towards the "doors"

Elevator Pitch: it revolves around a building called Lawang Sewu, a colonial-era building that has a thousand doors because it really does have lots of doors in it. Every door has its own theme about Colonialism History, the upper place or the ground floor is accessible by a tourist, but the underground section of the floor is forbidden by the public, and the whole building itself should be monitored and staffed with Foundation Guards.

Central Narrative: The narrative will focus on the exploration logs about these "doors" that are in the underground, at first it will be a normal abandoned underground room with an 1800-1900s theme, as the exploration goes deeper, it will get an even weirder and darker theme of the place itself, some of it may cause cognitive disturbances, and some may have an entity that is hostile and non-hostile. The Exploration team must explore the room to progress further into another room, the room itself appears to be not in order which results in every room they encounter is randomized every time they started the exploration.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Every room has its own theme, it tells how dark and cruel the colonization was. Tourists on the upper floor may see that colonization improved the country by a lot but in the underground, it tells the horrifying experience of being dictated by the upper echelon of that time. Tortured, discriminated, killed, etc by the colony. The Room expresses how the people back then were mistreated, some of the entities in the room being hostile because of it. The Foundation is still exploring the underground to know what really happened.

Additional Notes: I may add exploration logs also with some interviews with a non-hostile entity in the room to get a grasp of what does this room feels and its entity around it.

item.title: SCP-XXXX (Veracity)
item.description: Spooky polygraph makes whatever the subject says "come true".
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Technical SCP including developments associated with the testing of this SCP. Focus on addendums and Incident Reports to describe the Foundation’s efforts to contain and understand this object.

+ Elevator Pitch:
– hide block

Elevator Pitch:
Foundation Discovery of GRU-P Experiments at New Research Area Kantubek located on the Vozdrozhdeniya Isthmus (Formerly island) in the now diminishing Aral Sea region near the Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan border. SCP-XXXX is a Polygraph machine with cognitohazardous properties which affect those exposed to the results produced by the machine making them believe with certainty and without question the accuracy and truth of statements analyzed by the machine, even when presented with factual evidence to the contrary (cognitive dissonance). Further experimentation reveals additional congnitohazards associated with the machine as well as evidence of suspected retrocausal effects generated by the machine. Much of the story development in the article will occur via incident reports filed by Foundation personnel.

+ Central Narrative:
– hide block

Central Narrative:
SCP-XXXX is one of many SCPs the Foundation currently contains (or is attempting to contain) at Research Area Kantubek, formerly a GRU-P research and development facility. Central tension focuses around GRU-P mismanagement of anomalous items and persons and the implications of containment breaches. I would like to expand the story of SCP’s at Research Area Kantubek as well as create a number of tales which describe the lives and personal experiences of Foundation Personnel working within this former GRU-P compound. While this article is just to begin seeding plot ideas and characters regarding this small-ish setting, I would like to develop it into a larger series spanning around 20-25 years of Foundation efforts occurring at this area as well as their interactions with other GOI’s (and the associated physical, emotional and political challenges Foundation Personnel face here).

+ Hook/Attention-Grabber:
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
Focus on a relatively mundane object which is discovered to have exceptional properties beyond original Foundation expectations and the Foundations scramble to expand Special Containment Procedures.

+ Additional Notes:
– hide block

Additional Notes:
I’d like this article to be both enjoyable as a stand-alone read as well as effectively seed interest in the wider story regarding SCPs and Foundation Personnel at RA-Kantubek. I don’t want the first piece to be of too grand a scale as to overshadow future pieces, but it also needs to be involved enough as to hint at other developments and stories in RA-Kantubek. I’m also concerned about writing something too “big”, but I’m not sure how much content should be in a single SCP article to retain interest but also to decently seed plot points for future articles. Any input and feedback is welcome and appreciated!

item.title: Dystopan Afterlfe
item.description: Pay an Extra 25 Millenium to the Council of Death; Ephemeral™ to Experience a Shot of Endorphins™ in no less than 3 SHORT AEONS!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Dystopian

Elevator Pitch: An accurate version of hell portrayed as authoritarian capitalism run by Marshall, Carter, and Dark (Probably? Seems like something they would do. Not sure yet). It is a dystopian pocket dimension designed as an afterlife in which people have to torture eachother for feelings and memories.

Attention Hook: The ruling body of the afterlife is run by 13 members of something called ¨The Council of Death, Ephemeral¨. Maybe this has something to do with the 05s? Who knows.

Central Narrative: An MTF enters the pocket dimension and explores the place. They feel as if they are missing out on time, as if one minute here is 10 days in the real world but they want to stay here by an anomalous source of somnilence.

Additional Notes: I got this from a Tom Scott video I watched a while back. Please note that I have absolutely nothing wrong with authoritarian capitalism and I do not want to portray that as hell. I do not have a bias against it, I am just exaggerating it with a shot of Marshall, Carter and Dark. Let me know what you think, any and all appreciation is accepted! :)

item.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time
item.description: A pitch for a tale about someone with an instance of SCP-2806, specifically the interrogation between capture and Skywalker Protocol (amputation and amnestics)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Page Layout (Optional): Interview

Elevator Pitch: A Lawgiver has apprehended someone who acquired a Gyrfalcon series prosthetic arm. Skywalker Protocol is very clear about what happens next, but before she wipes his memory she wants to get some information. The interview includes background on how a civilian came into possession of an SCP object and what his specific instance does. Then it gets interrupted by a security breach regarding something else at the same site…to be continued…

Central Narrative: This serves as an introduction for two characters that I intend to make part of a larger series of tales that serves as their origin story to enter Alpha-9, making this a bridge between Those Twisted Pines and Ressurection Canons.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A simple interview with a simple man reveals a lot of information from somebody who doesn't know what he knows and hints at a lot more to come. May involve Olympia and the Black Queen.

Additional Notes: These characters are intended for Alpha-9, but not because they're "so cool" but rather because we have no where else to put them. SCP-2806-21-A is in way over his head and he knows it but after he survives the security breach (barely, more by luck than ability) he gets an offer he can't refuse, literally. The agent becomes his partner but really, she's the insurance policy and if he ever gets compromised she takes the arm and administers an amnestic or terminates him as the situation allows.

item.title: The Zenwalker (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: A tragic complex story of a powerful entity playing hero
item.content:encoded:
A tragic complex story of a powerful entity playing hero only to become the only threat he ever had to worry about.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Cosmic Horror, Drama/Emotional,

Page Layout (Optional): This is going to be a rare case of and scp article in an scp article. There will be the normal containment procedures followed by a description then an addendum containing an scp article about this scp that he brought with him from the future (I know, bare with me). After the addendum, logs reviewing the interviews with the scp.

Elevator Pitch: Basically, this scp is an anomalous man from a different dimension in which the laws of physics are fundamentally different. It's because of this difference that he has the ability to manipulate gravity. His upbringing and childlike curiosity provided the perfect origin story for a modern superhero with a scientific alter ego. By day he was a lab coat pushing the limits of his abilities to fully understand gravity and it's effects, by night a merciless vigilante obliterating local crime with an iron fist.

+ show block
– hide block

Now, I know what it looks like but stay with me, this isn't just another superhero. In fact, the true danger of this scp came from his day job as a scientist. His continuous experiments yielded amazing discoveries about what he could do, but it eventually led to the collapse of the universe as we know it. The collapse of the universe damned him to just exist in an existence in which he was the only thing that excited. Madness had claimed him after a millennia of solitude, but he didn't spend his time in the void laying down. He used this time to further study his ability. Eventually he was able to feel the connection between time and gravity. This led his ability to manipulate time. From there he formulated a plan to send himself back in time to kill his younger self before he collapses the universe. However, do to his mental instability he was slain his younger self. That younger version of himself grew to repeat history/the future and collapsed the universe, went mad, discovered time travel, and repeated the plan to kill his younger self. This time however, he remembered how he defeated his older self and didn't fall for the same tactic he used when he was younger. This caused the fight to last a while longer than the first fight. However, the younger version of himself still came out on top do to his mental edge. This younger version of himself repeated the same cycle extending the fight just a bit longer. As the cycle continued the scale of the battle grew larger, so did the foundation's involvement. This only served to escalate the situation as it eventually led to a broken masquerade. This cycle repeated until the battle was the cause of the collapsed universe. The cycle finally ended when he decided to instead travel farther back in time and seek out the foundation to contain his younger self before he grows up to become a threat. The conversation with a mad man didn't get nearly as far as the scp article he brought back with him as proof of his claims. The article inside the article is the one he brought back with him and the over all article will be the whole story.

Central Narrative: It's a tragic story of a hero being his only threat. Eventually ending the narrative before it starts.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The very deeply rooted story.

Additional Notes: This is my first attribution to the site in general and I'm sure I have a lot to learn. This is me diving head first into a community I've loved for years and should have contributed to ages ago. All criticism welcome and appreciated.

item.title: Human Fungi
item.description: A fungi in which infects humans.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX represents a single species of fungi, currently only known to exist within northern Queensland, Australia. SCP-XXXX is similar to the genus Ophiocordyceps, as SCP-XXXX has the ability to infect Insectoids, Birds, and Mamalians including Humans. Once an individual has been infected with SCP-XXXX (now designated SCP-XXXX-1) during early stages will begin to suppress the individual's consciousness and hijack the brain. SCP-XXXX has the ability to tap into the memories of SCP-XXXX-1, because of this SCP-XXXX-1 are able to basic human things such as communicating, movement, etc

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX during late stages will use the SCP-XXXX-1 instance to move to a suitable location to multiply. Once achieved SCP-XXXX-1 will attach itself to a surface, as well as immobilising itself by placing a cocoon like structure around its body. From here spores will begin to fly out of SCP-XXXX-1, which will multiply SCP-XXXX

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Numerous SCP-XXXX-1 instances have been leaked (and deleted of course) however one was able to communicate directly to an non-infected individual via text. This is where the story will take place.

item.title: The Naga
item.description: A predator looking for its next meal? Or something worse...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: An interdimensional creature that is crossed between a snake and a fish. How it first picks its target is unknown, but it relentlessly chases those that have seen the light it reflects and ignores all else.

Central Narrative: Strange disappearances of wildlife and citizens alike have been happening recently in the western part of Chiang Mai, Thailand.

The first reported sighting of the SCP occurred when a couple went visiting the Doi Inthanon National Park, only for the man to disappear and the woman being the sole witness. This spreads the belief that what the woman had seen was a Naga, a guardian spirit. What the woman reported is as follows:

  • The creature appeared to be some weird fish that lacked most fins
  • It was able to glide through the air, typically staying several hundred feet up
  • It could form light from its scales and its face was glowing

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Some citizens have drawn to a conclusion that the SCP could possibly be a Naga seeking out possessed or evil souls found within people, or perhaps it’s a rogue spirit.

Additional Notes: N/A

item.title: Your friendly neighborhood demon
item.description: A completely incompetent demon is summoned by a researcher
item.content:encoded:
A completely incompetent demon is summoned by a researcher. The researcher gets terminated and the demon tries (miserably) to do its job.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mostly comedy, secondly psychological.

Page Layout:

+ show block
– hide block

Class and ConProcs before and after the “incident”. Description of the Book and, adding the “as of dd/mm/yyyy” the description of the Entity. At least three Interview logs with the entity (or just one log with multiple “extracts” to give the idea). An example of a contract the entity would propose (with a lot of Latin and high-sounding words of jurisprudence to give it an overly serious characterization to contrast the demon’s one) and, finally, a note from Hell itself.

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP will be composed of two parts:
• A book, which the Foundation seized, that describes various thaumaturgical/satanical rituals. One of these being the summoning of demons.
• A weak and lower demon, summoned by a Researcher trying to bargain for money, power, etc. The demon is rather “stupid”. It’s forcibly stuck in the room he was summoned in due to the blood glyph drawn on the floor and his only goal is to acquire as many souls as he can.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

The demon acts all high and mighty, like a stereotypical devil from fantasy literature, talking big and trying to sway people into making contracts with it. It is, however, extremely weak and incompetent. Gets easily irritated, lies terribly, and doesn’t seem to be able to trick anyone into doing anything evil. Quite on the contrary it seems that people behave better around him, much to its irritation.
Meanwhile through the interview logs the reader experiences the reaction to the loss of the researcher that summoned it, that was terminated for his abuse. The conversations with the demon will parallel a possible set of reactions to the Foundation methods in dealing with rule breakers.
In the end a note will be found in the site director’s office thanking the Foundation for containing the demon without exorcising him back, humorously hinting that the demon was so incompetent that he was disliked in Hell.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

+ show block
– hide block

Most of the article features a comedic style derived from the stereotypical “big demon” behavior being attributed to such a wimpy and incapable creature, its inefficient methods and, lastly his frustration about it.
On the other side readers will delve into some possible reactions to the idea that someone you worked with every day, maybe even dated or considered a friend, has been literally killed for breaking the rules at work. Even if working at the Foundation they are still human beings after all.

Additional Notes:

+ show block
– hide block

Hiding behind a copious humorous screen there will be a cynical reasoning about the Foundation methods and, above all, their impact on personnel. I think this "laugh and think" style could prove functional.

item.title: Mommy Theres a Man Outside (Seeking Green Lights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Pitch:
SCP-4666 is a terrifying entity force, and essentially unstoppable. The entry log is scary, but how horrifying would it be to be a part of one of the entities hunts?

Central Narrative: The story follows a little boy and his family who live in rural Germany, the story starting off at night with the little boy shouting for his mother "Mommy, mommy! There's a man outside!" the family then doesn't see the man and the story would progress through the different stages of the hunt all the way until the end in which 4666 kills the family and kidnaps the boy the end of the story would then switch perspectives to a boy in rural Ireland who is shouting, "Mommy, mommy! There's a man outside!"

Attention Grabber: Christmas isn't the time for laughter and cheer anymore

Additional Notes: I actually told a story similar to this as a camp fire story, thought it would be interesting as a tale, feedback of any kind is appreciated :) Hope you enjoyed, and hope you're having a Merry Christmas

item.title: SCP-TBD: The Extradimensional Grand Station
item.description: What if there was a subway system that went everywhere
item.content:encoded:
What if there was a subway system that went everywhere and everywhen? What if it went to pasts, presents, and futures where events unfolded differently? What wonderous possibilities could be waiting? And what untold horrors?

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up a lot of space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Document/Exploratory File

Elevator Pitch:

  • Entrance to anomaly first found in the form of an undocumented stairway in the New York City Subway shortly after 9/11.
  • This stairway, officially listed as SCP-TBD, also known as the Extradimensional Stairway by SCP personnel, leads to a massive series of passageways, officially listed as SCP-TBD-1
  • Visitors are guided by instances of artificial lifeforms consisting of programable matter/nanites. These instances take the form of the species they are interacting with.
  • This facility is controlled by a highly advanced AI system.
+ show block
– hide block
  • Due to the size of this facility, transportation to entrances are provided by a series of vacuum trains. According to readings provided by the onboard interfaces and the body-suit sensors worn by exploratory teams, these trains are capable of accelerating quickly to hypersonic speeds, but without producing the associated g-forces that would normally kill their occupants.

Central Narrative: Anomaly is a massive underground system that leads to an as yet undetermined number of places, including different planets and alternate realities. Various different species and alternate versions of humanity use this system, and the facility can be inhabited by a minimum of beings ranging in the thousands on any day.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The finished article will list exploratory expeditions to different planets in the prime reality, as well as into different timelines. Many different references to different SCPs and settings will be included, such as instances of SCP-682 being escorted back to their stairway entrance, one by an android dragging him in a stun net (kicking, screaming, and shouting insults and threats), while the witnessing MTF just looks on, and an instance of a reality where the Foundation and anomalies has been disclosed to the public.

Additional Notes:
This is my first SCP entry. I currently have two versions of this working in my head: one is more positive and optimistic, and is my preferred direction. Then there is another that is abandoned, inhabited by an insane AI, malfunctioning killer androids, and horrors from alternate dimensions that have wandered into the system. Idea is extrapolated from some dreams I've had in the past, namely the vast vacuum train system and stairways that go deep underground and into a maze of passageways.

item.title: A helping hand (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This SCP involves a floating hand which assists people with things when they are needed, the SCP teleports to anyone who says they need help with something, this will not work if they are only thinking of needing help and not saying it,

Central Narrative: The hand is cut off at the wrist area, the inside shows a black void.
Testing showed that it can only help with things if it's within a 5 meter radius and will help with anything it can, it can hammer a nail in the wall, or shoot a target as long as it's within 5 meters of the person needing help.

It can't hold more than 15kg, it seems that anything put on the scp was taken with it, that's how the tracker was placed and kept tracking it, it seems to always help and has no sign of stopping but it only appears around 2 times per week max, and it will also do the task really fast, the foundation was able to snap one photo however

It is able to teleport anywhere on the world and wont stay any longer than needed so containment isn't possible and has since been classified as Euclid, it's presence was noticed by the foundation in 2011 when a twitter user Robert Hexain posted a message about the SCP who helped him repair his roof.

When there are multiple people in need of assistance it will randomly choose one to help and will help the other later if they still need help, during testing a tracker was put on the SCP to locate it at all times to see who the SCP helped, they will then be tracked down, interviewed and given Class B amnestics

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It can be helpful or it can be really dangerous

item.title: You're It (SCP concept)
item.description: An affliction that causes individuals to attack others and pass on the affliction
item.content:encoded:
An affliction that causes individuals to attack others and pass on the affliction to survivors of the attacks. Those affected by this SCP will cease to be afflicted after passing it on.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

This SCP is a phenomenon that causes afflicted individuals to quickly become more hostile and violent towards others, as well as giving them increased physical strength and resistance to injury. The exact cause of this is unknown, as no pathogen or other potential source has yet to be identified. This SCP will likely cause affected individuals to attack nearby people, often resulting in their deaths. Those who survive these attacks will begin to exhibit the same anomalous effects as their attacker, while the attacker will slowly lose the aggression and increased strength.

Those that have "passed on" the SCP have a moderate chance to die of multiple organ failure after the effects have subsided, and those that live retain memories of their actions while under the influence of this SCP. Should the current carrier of this SCP die before passing it on, it will instead be passed on to the carrier's killer. If the carrier was not killed by a sapient being, the SCP will instead pass on to a random individual, where nearer individuals are more likely to be afflicted.

This SCP is contained via an afflicted D-Class personnel inside a reinforced concrete humanoid containment chamber. The D-Class is kept alive as long as possible, and their vitals are constantly monitored. Additional D-Class personnel are introduced into the chamber to allow the SCP to be passed on. The previous carrier will be tranquilized via remotely controlled sentries before they can kill the new carrier. The previous carrier, now sedated, is removed from the chamber and amnestics are administered.
